overclaims: The unknown accounting basis independently prevents a supported or contradicted money assessment.
Without comparable spending, assets and commitments, choosing a ranking would depend on definitions Marcus did not supply.
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, scope condition, axis, outcome and citations all match. The rationale goes beyond the case in two places. First, the contract treats USD as a comparison convention and never says the unknown accounting basis blocks resolution. Large rank gaps could hold under any basis, so 'independently prevents' overclaims. Second, the contract already defines spending, assets and commitments. The real gap is missing comparable records, not definitions Marcus failed to give.
